reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. Aster documents asUSDF as the yield-bearing token received by staking USDF, with NAV set by the strategies backing USDF. At BNB Chain block 118819303 (hash 0xf3d8b1d6d144998ddd1f31562c07bda0b1614ef685a63b3ce01837001f621ac5; 2026-08-29T18:56:38Z), public RPC eth_call reads on asUSDFEarn 0xdb57a53c428a9fafcbfeffb6dd80d0f427543695 returned USDF() = 0x5a110fC00474038f6c02E89C707D638602EA44B5 and asUSDF() = 0x917AF46B3C3c6e1Bb7286B9F59637Fb7C65851Fb; USDF.balanceOf(asUSDFEarn) was 2,960,981.376879277 and asUSDF.totalSupply() was 2,778,084.534595421, with exchangePrice() = 1.065834078079115961. The verified wrapper source transfers deposited USDF into asUSDFEarn before minting calculated asUSDF shares, so the direct reserve is one 100% USDF wrapper position. The row links the tracked usdf-astherus parent; its upstream USDT custody and delta-neutral strategy exposures are inherited and not duplicated here.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Source-scoped correction researched 2026-10-20, preserving the 2026-07-20 review start: the cited FAQ, minting guide and wrapper code establish no enforceable holder-level bankruptcy treatment. The prior bankruptcyRemoteness none was inferred from absent legal documentation; unknown is the supported state, without favorable legal-protection credit. Deposited USDF sits in the asUSDFEarn wrapper contract; the historical BSC blocks 110184782/110184820 establish a six-hour upgrade timelock and ADMIN_ROLE pause capability. The prohibited rehypothecation annotation is scoped only to this wrapper's deposited USDF: the pinned asUSDFEarn source transfers deposits into its own balance, values shares against that balance, and transfers the parent token to WITHDRAW_VAULT when a holder requests withdrawal. Neither asUSDFEarn nor its inherited Withdrawable contract exposes a lending or strategy-allocation entrypoint for those deposits. This does not remove the separately reviewed upgrade and withdrawal-control risks. Upstream USDT is transferred to Aster's Ceffu account and deployed into delta-neutral positions; that documented economic reuse remains upstream on usdf-astherus, not an additional reuse of asUSDF's deposited parent tokens. Ceffu account terms, venue-level segregation, insolvency priority and provider shares remain unpublished. asUSDF-to-USDF withdrawal is documented at T+1 hour (two hours); upstream USDF-to-USDT processing is 1-2 days standard and up to seven days for large amounts, without a final-payout guarantee.
